implementation: Prepared secure rosters use membership/layout reconciliation without reinstalling header attributes/drivers or Party.ApplyOptions. Startup/unavailable readiness retains full configuration/native fallback. Combat defers ordinary reconciliation; prepared native drivers remain authoritative.
Group unit paints reuse existing next-frame paint driver instead of synchronous repeated full paints. Changed unit attributes still bind immediately.
Normal party/pet OnShow and roster events share one batch; preserve current cast reset/resample, indicators and range wake. Ready-check and other immediate events retain behavior.
Optional45pet/friendly-target cells retain drivers/layout/units and coalesce roster paints; deferred option changes still apply at regen.

Hover discovery coalesced per existing0.3second timer; one discovery, no stable roster routing rebuild. Edit Mode, routing invalidation, UPDATE_BINDINGS and combat deferred registration retain full refresh. Known registered frames bypass repeated classification.

Friendly debuff tint refreshes party native owners for roster identity changes, only reevaluates target/focus friendliness and leaves player aura work to UNIT_AURA. Known/unknown and strict-checkbox rules preserved.
Prepared readiness also checks player-style party initialization. Optional adjunct pending/error state retains setup retry on group updates.
